_comment: Application names. They live in each title's SMDH (ExeFS:/icon) in NAND, so LayeredFS cannot replace them - code.ips does, two different ways depending on the title. A title that reads SMDHs itself gets its buffer rewritten (tools/smdh_names.py); one that only receives finished strings gets the pointer swapped by matching the name of the language this build replaces (tools/pane_names.py). `ua` is the short description: one line, the icon label. `ua_long` is the long description and carries its own line break, the way Nintendo's own SMDHs do; omit it when it equals `ua`. `ru`/`ru_long` are the Russian originals the `from-ru` build matches, `en`/`en_long` the English ones the `from-en` build matches - see tools/variant.py. Either may be a list when the exact spelling is not yet confirmed on hardware - a spelling that never matches costs table bytes and nothing else.

0004001000022300.ru_long: Информация о здоровье и безопасности Nintendo
0004001000022300.ua_long:
